proof_strategy.tdd: The split-brain evidence contract first failed because this manifest and checksum did not exist; ownership behavior was first expressed by failing reconciliation and namespace-label tests.
proof_strategy.edd: The manifest records audit IDs, exact actor identity, call pattern, live RBAC containment, code revision, tests, capacity impact, and the blocked deployment state.
proof_strategy.cdd: The reconciliation contract now requires a database-backed session snapshot and an explicit control-plane owner before namespace deletion.
proof_strategy.bdd: Given two control planes with different session databases, when either reconciles Arena, then it can enumerate and delete only namespaces stamped with its own control-plane identity.
proof_strategy.cbt: Audit identity, workload service accounts, RBAC revocation, reconciliation selection, namespace labeling, capacity preview, and deployment reachability were checked separately.
